raw_response: Banks reported that investment banking fees rebounded in 2024 after a sluggish environment in 2023. In Q4 2023, Bank of America’s overall investment banking fees were $1.1 billion, growing 7% year-over-year despite an industry fee pool down 8%. By Q4 2024, Bank of America’s investment banking fees rose to $1.7 billion, a 44% increase year-over-year, driven by mergers and acquisitions, debt capital markets (particularly leveraged finance), and equity capital markets. Goldman Sachs also reported record financing revenues across FICC and Equities in 2024, rising 17% to $9.1 billion.
